leadRow.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents

evidence.sourceTitle: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
evidence.significance: OpenAI reports that its limited-access model developed working exploits for 948 Linux kernel vulnerabilities and produced 81 novel Firefox findings classified high severity by Mozilla; Mozilla began fixes. OpenAI classifies it as Critical under its own framework and reports improved scope compliance. These are provider-reported results; they do not establish customer outcomes or independent safeguard effectiveness.

sourceDateVerification.reason: OpenAI's primary 5 November announcement states 81 novel Firefox vulnerabilities, 948 Linux kernel exploits, Mozilla fixes, limited access and its own Critical classification.

leadRow.title: PRA creates a directorate for operational and cyber resilience
leadRow.source: Primary / Bank of England and Prudential Regulation Authority / 2026-10-22

evidence.sourceTitle: Mansion House City Regulators Dinner – speech by Katharine Braddick
evidence.organisation: Bank of England and Prudential Regulation Authority
evidence.significance: The PRA announced a directorate reporting directly to its CEO for operational and cyber resilience, alongside a joint FCA consultation expected by year-end. This is strategic direction and planned consultation, not a current new rule.

sourceDateVerification.reason: PRA primary speech page displays publication date 22 October 2026 and states the new directorate and intended joint FCA consultation.

leadRow.title: CMORG holds sector-wide cloud outage simulation exercise
leadRow.source: Primary / Bank of England and Prudential Regulation Authority / 2026-10-09

evidence.sourceTitle: CMORG holds sector-wide cloud outage simulation exercise
evidence.organisation: Bank of England and Prudential Regulation Authority
evidence.significance: SIMEX26 involved 38 major banks and market infrastructure operators responding to a global cloud-services disruption scenario. The Bank of England says firms are expected to take action from the exercise. Participation shows rehearsal, not recovery capability; the practical test is whether findings changed service plans, supplier arrangements or response decisions.

leadRow.title: Market Participants Survey results - November 2026
leadRow.source: Primary / Bank of England and Prudential Regulation Authority / 2026-11-06

evidence.organisation: Bank of England and Prudential Regulation Authority
evidence.significance: The survey was open 21–23 October and received responses from 80 selected market participants. Published median expectations placed Bank Rate at 4.00% after the December meeting and 4.25% in February and March 2027. These are respondents' expectations, not an MPC decision or Bank forecast. Use as a scenario input for borrowers and infrastructure providers exposed to financing-cost changes.

sourceDateVerification.reason: The Bank of England page is dated 6 November 2026 and states the 80-respondent base and question-level median Bank Rate expectations.

leadRow.title: OFSI grants a time-bound licence to wind down Zarubezhneft transactions
leadRow.source: Primary / UK Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation / 2026-10-08

evidence.organisation: UK Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation
evidence.significance: OFSI's licence permits defined persons and relevant UK institutions to wind down or divest from transactions involving Zarubezhneft JSC or its subsidiaries. It runs from 8 October to 21 November 2026 and requires complete, readable records for six years. Firms should confirm entity ownership, transaction scope and licence conditions before relying on the permission.

leadRow.title: ARTEX abuse expands as cybercriminals target financial sector

evidence.sourceTitle: ARTEX abuse expands as cybercriminals target financial sector
evidence.significance: Microsoft Threat Intelligence says Storm-3358 used the agentic framework ARTEX alongside conventional tools to scan public-facing systems, exploit web-application flaws and use compromised credentials and cloud identities for persistence and data exfiltration. This is Microsoft's observed activity account, not a prevalence estimate. Test internet-facing exposure, identity controls, lateral-movement detection and containment.

sourceDateVerification.reason: Microsoft's primary Threat Intelligence article is dated 6 November 2026 and describes Storm-3358's use of ARTEX against financial-sector organisations.

leadRow.title: Google Cloud’s London region outage exposes cross-zone recovery limits

evidence.sourceTitle: Google Cloud Service Health incident: europe-west2
evidence.significance: Google’s preliminary report describes a power event in europe-west2-b followed by capacity constraints and impact across the London region. Firms should check whether cross-zone failover and critical-service recovery work under regional control-plane and capacity stress.

sourceDateVerification.reason: Google Cloud Status incident page states the event date as 20 October and describes the europe-west2-b power event and subsequent regional impacts.

leadRow.title: European regulators link data protection with value in finance
leadRow.source: Primary / Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés / 2026-10-16

evidence.sourceTitle: De la protection des données à la création de valeur en finance : des autorités européennes publient une étude et des bonnes pratiques
evidence.organisation: Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés
evidence.significance: CNIL, the UK ICO and Luxembourg’s CNPD jointly examine how data protection and governance affect trust, resilience, AI use and the valuation of financial data. This is joint analysis and good practice, not a new rule.

sourceDateVerification.reason: The CNIL primary page displays 16 October 2026 beneath the headline and describes the joint CNIL, ICO and CNPD study. The date was checked directly on the primary page.
